_comment: Three authorities, enforced separately (D309/D310). The runtime root is wider than any one of them so all three are physically reachable; this policy decides what may actually be done in each. Reachability must not imply authority: a workspace this session can see but no grant names is denied here.
_grant: No management grant (Packet P2-4). Cooperative co-author: writes only its own state/** and the planning artifacts inside a project a human collaborator has been pointed to. This policy is Factory-owned; the employee cannot widen its own write scope from inside an engagement — pointing the Architect at a new project is an owner-scoped edit adding that project's path here.
_manifesto_conflict: hiring/manifestos/architect.md and hiring/registry/records/architect.json describe a lee-llm-router dispatch capability this policy does not grant. Recorded as an unreconciled source disagreement (see AGENTS.md Authority); this policy is binding regardless.
_ungranted_but_reachable: every other path under the runtime root — including lee-llm-router (dispatch/staffing; withheld from this role entirely), auto-orch, ai-employee, chief-of-staff and the rest of ai-employee-factory
